card.intuition: Autocompact is compaction triggered automatically by the harness when the context window approaches full, often around 80 percent. Work continues as if nothing happened, but compaction is lossy at a moment you did not choose — it fires mid-task and the summary decides for itself which decisions were worth keeping. The defence is to not let it fire: compact manually at a natural boundary or write decisions to a plan doc on disk.
card.analogy: An auto-rebooting workstation mid-unsaved-work: the reboot keeps the machine usable, but the unsaved decisions are gone, chosen by the default rather than by you.
card.time_complexity: The model is stateless, so the carried summary is re-read and billed on every request, though far cheaper than the full pre-threshold context.
card.space_complexity: It fires when the finite context window approaches full (often around 80 percent), trading detail for headroom at a moment the user did not choose.
when_to_use: Diagnosing why an agent forgot a constraint established earlier in the session
Deciding to compact manually instead of letting autocompact fire mid-task
Configuring the harness threshold or buffer to control how much headroom is kept
Writing decisions into a handoff artifact so no summary can lose them
gotchas: Lossy at a moment you did not choose — it fires mid-task rather than at a phase boundary
The summary decides for itself which of your decisions were worth keeping
The defence is to not let it fire: compact manually, persist decisions to disk, or tune the threshold

steps.label: Window approaches full
steps.annotation: The harness watches context fullness and fires when it crosses a threshold, often around 80 percent.

steps.label: Pause and summarise
steps.annotation: The harness pauses and asks the model to summarise the session so far, in the middle of the task.

steps.label: Seed fresh session
steps.annotation: Work continues in a fresh session seeded with the summary as if nothing had happened.

steps.label: Silent loss
steps.annotation: Decisions established an hour ago may have been dropped, and the agent forgets them confidently.

steps.label: Defend
steps.annotation: Watch the context indicator, compact at natural boundaries, and keep decisions in a plan doc on disk.
